messages:
ella: urgent: we're seeing compatibility errors for SDK 3.0 clients after runtime 4.0.0 rollout. Error spike in EU and US: 502s + stream disconnects. Recommend emergency unpin to 3.9.5.

ryan: saw same in prod metrics. Client header shows `x-sdk: 3.0.1` failing ~4% of requests since 02:12 UTC.

qa-sam: repro in staging: SDK 3.0.1 + runtime 4.0.0 -> streaming frames occasionally dropped. Log: `stream: unexpected EOF while reading frame`

dev-bot: deploy issue created: #4219 "runtime 4.0.0 -> rollback/unpin due to SDK 3.0 incompat"

ops: can we target only traffic from SDK 3.0 or do we need full rollback?

ella: we're splitting hairs. ~65% of failing requests are SDK 3.0 family. But there are also server-side integrations lacking sdk header. Safer to unpin cluster to 3.9.5 for now.

infra-lin: quick question: does 3.9.5 have any security or kernel regressions vs 4.0.0? ops: 3.9.5 matches our baseline, no known sec fixes missing for this hot rollback window.

pm-kate: timeline: can we do a fast rollback at 03:00 UTC with 30m notice? we should notify customers on managed plans.

dev-bot: rollback plan draft: 1) pause canary expansion 2) set default runtime to 3.9.5 via `deploybot set-default-runtime global 3.9.5` 3) drain 4.0.0 nodes and shift traffic over 15m 4) monitor error rate and latency 5) if issues persist, open incident.

ryan: I'll own the rollback exec. Ella pls pin me on the runbook and grant temp privileges.

ella: adding runbook to ticket and attaching quick commands. Also adding a safe-mode throttle: `deploybot throttle cluster-eu 0.5` to limit impact while we flip.

qa-sam: will run regression smoke: - batch and streaming flows - kv cache warmup - auth checks

dev-bot: telemetry note: SDK header present in ~70% of traffic. For the rest, we will treat conservatively.

ops: approving emergency unpin. Add rollback checklist and contact points. Also request a postmortem after stabilization.

ella: done. I added contact list: oncall, infra-lin, ryan, qa-sam, pm-kate. Ticket #4219 updated.

infra-lin: I'll prepare the node drain playbook and pre-warm 3.9.5 bundles on the cluster to reduce cold start.

ryan: starting rollback at 03:05 UTC (target complete by 03:25 UTC). Executing `deploybot set-default-runtime global 3.9.5` now.

dev-bot: command received: set-default-runtime global 3.9.5 | started at 2024-08-01T03:05:12Z

qa-sam: monitoring: initial error rate dropping from 3.8% -> 1.1% within 5m. streaming disconnects reduced.

ella: keep watch on the SDK 3.0 cohort specifically. We need to communicate timeline to CS.

pm-kate: messaging queued: "We detected SDK interoperability issues after runtime 4.0.0; we've temporarily reverted to 3.9.5 while we investigate. Apologies for any disruption; we will follow up with ETA for full fix." Send at 03:15 UTC.

ops: confirm rollback complete?

dev-bot: rollback complete: default runtime = 3.9.5 | completed at 2024-08-01T03:22:45Z | canary pools drained: 4.0.0 -> 3.9.5

ryan: verified. Error rate stabilized at 0.2%. Latency within normal baseline.

infra-lin: keeping 4.0.0 bundles available on staging for reproduce. Will add extended tracing for streaming frames in a special debug build.

ella: next steps: - triage root cause with runtime team (lin) - reproduce with SDK 3.0 instruments (ryan + qa-sam) - decide: patch runtime 4.0.1 or ship SDK 3.0.2 compat shim.

pm-kate: schedule a small cross-team sync at 09:00 UTC to scope postmortem and messaging.

dev-bot: follow-up tasks created in #4219: triage, instrumentation, customer comms, postmortem.

ops: thanks team. Keep #all-hands-infra posted if we escalate.

ella: closing thread for now. Will reopen if errors recur.
